readback.name: Poincare.poincare_conjecture
readback.mathematical_statement: Universe-polymorphic in arbitrary u: for every type M : Type u, every supplied topology on M, and every supplied Hausdorff, Euclidean-three-dimensional charted-space, simply-connected, and compact instance for that topology, there exists a homeomorphism from M to the subtype Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 4)) (1 : ℝ), with its standard induced topology. The target is the unit 3-sphere in real Euclidean 4-space. ChartedSpace uses open partial homeomorphisms to Euclidean 3-space and covers every point, so the manifold has no boundary. SimplyConnectedSpace excludes the empty space and asserts path connectivity with unique paths up to homotopy. Nonempty (M ≃ₜ S³) asserts existence of a bijection with continuous forward and inverse maps, not merely a homotopy equivalence. The conclusion concerns the original topology on M. No smoothness, supplied smooth atlas, Hamilton, convergence, Ricci-flow, or sphere-recognition premise appears. The universe binder, input instance quantifiers, and conclusion agree exactly with the pinned Poincare.PoincareConjectureStatement after unfolding its ThreeSphere abbreviation; no discrepancy or weakening was found.
